newsitem.title: TUNISIA: World Bank official discusses loans with Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: World Bank official discusses loans with Tunisia.

text.p: A senior World Bank official on Saturday held talks with the Tunisian government over financing development projects during the next five years, Tunisian officials said.

Daniel Ritchie, World Bank regional director, discussed with Tunisian Economic Development Minister Taoufik Baccar the Internationl Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) financing of projects in Tunisia's ninth development plan from 1997-2001, they said.
IBRD is the World Bank's main lending body.

Ritchie told Reuters earlier in July that the World Bank plans to lend Tunisia about $750 million over the next three years to help it integrate into global economy but wants the North African country to implement faster economic reforms.
